title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100V — Specification

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 694 specifies requirements for PVC insulated cables and flexible cords with working voltages up to 1100V. Covers single-core and multi-core cables used for domestic wiring, industrial installations, and general power supply. PVC cables are under mandatory ISI certification — all cables must bear the ISI mark with CM/L number.
